messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "The team needs both automatic claim routing by postcode and workload, and manual routing control for complex cases, but the system lacks configurable per‑team routing options.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing. We need manual claim routing options configurable per team.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-21T14:33:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Our commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing — we need manual claim routing for those, while motor claims can stay automated by postcode and workload.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T09:57:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We don’t want to force one approach across all teams... Per-team configuration would solve it... prefers manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  }
 ],
 "title": "The team needs both automatic claim routing by postcode and workload, and"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The problem statement claims the system lacks configurable per-team routing options, and the quotes from support and onboarding consistently describe the same gap: teams want automatic postcode/workload routing for some teams (e.g., motor) but manual routing for complex cases (e.g., specialty/commercial), and one-size-fits-all configuration doesn't work. All three quotes align with the title and statement, none are praise, none are answerable by a help article, and the cause lies within the product's configurability rather than pricing, contracts, or customer IT. This is a actionable feature gap a squad could address.", "verdict": "pass"}
